name: Chuoi kho Tran Hoi
summary: Chuối khô Trần Hợi is dried banana from Trần Hợi, a collective trademark and the sweet on Cà Mau's gift list.
origin: Trần Hợi. Nhân Dân lists the collective mark, and Vietnam Airlines puts chuối khô on its Cà Mau gift list.
howToEat: Carry it home as a sweet.
